tools.name: get_streamkap_overview
tools.description: Fetch the Streamkap /llms.txt summary — a plain-text overview of the product, connectors, resources, and docs. Returns the raw markdown text.

tools.name: get_streamkap_page_as_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any Streamkap marketing page (pricing, platform, agents, blog posts, resources, connector pages, etc.) as markdown. Provide the pathname starting with "/".

tools.name: request_streamkap_demo
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to the Streamkap demo-request form. Use when the user wants to talk to sales or book a demo.
